notes: Chunk 98: 25 candidates reviewed from saved text; 3 program-list, 0 single-record, 22 not-a-list. Institutions kept as given by host. The two University at Buffalo School of Management pages are the Operations Management and Strategy (8 names) and Organization and Human Resources (about 58 names) PhD alumni lists; both give an 'Initial Appointment' employer per graduate but no graduation years, so cohorts must come from other sources; the OHR page is outside operations and is kept under the any-area-of-a-business-school rule. The UBC Sauder 'Alumni Stories' page lists only three PhD alumni (OBHR 2014, Finance 2016, Marketing 2015) with their assistant-professor positions as of the 2017 capture; the positions are current affiliations, not stated first jobs, and none is in operations; the page's sibling 'Career Outcomes' link is not in this batch. Pages with named dissertation authors but outside management (UPF journalism supervised dissertations, Bath politics supervised thesis, Arizona American Indian Studies dissertation, Bologna computer-science master's thesis, Berkeley Blum Center engineering graduates, Tilburg committee-membership record for an Aarhus defense) were marked not-a-list on the field rule, not because they lack names. No page plainly belongs to another institution in the data.
